{{Quote|The members of the Dark Council fought Arcann's invasion ruthlessly&mdash;and lost. The Empire's treaty was ultimately negotiated by the Minister of Logistics.|Lana Beniko|<ref name="Chapter 4" />}}
A '''treaty''' was negotiated between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Eternal Empire]] by the [[Minister of Logistics]] during the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Eternal Empire's conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The treaty ended the Eternal Empire's assault upon the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, but forced the Sith to begin paying a heavy tribute of raw materials and resources, as well as an arms limitation statute that the Sith Empire broke in secret.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

The treaty would be nullified when the Sith Empire [[Invasion of Voss|intervened]] in the [[War against Zakuul|war with the Eternal Empire]] on behalf of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against [[Zakuul]].
